face_truth_lines.sovereign: Authority is proven by outcomes held to the aim, not by volume.
face_truth_lines.visionary: Vision is validated by one shipped object at a time.
face_truth_lines.rebel: The break counts only when a build stands in its place.
face_truth_lines.equalizer: Balance is correct placement, not retroactive payback.
face_truth_lines.provider: Sustainable care includes the caregiver by design.
face_truth_lines.wanderer: Chosen commitments expand freedom rather than shrink it.
face_truth_lines.seeker: A claim becomes truth only when acted on and measured.
face_truth_lines.mask: Durable fit requires the real voice to lead.
face_truth_lines.partner: Loyalty strengthens when separateness is intact.
face_truth_lines.guardian: Safety is boundary clarity, not thicker walls.
face_truth_lines.servant: Real service stands on a spine, not surrender.
face_truth_lines.spotlight: Visibility is a by-product of shipped proof.
face_truth_lines.architect: The clean system is the one that ships and then improves.
face_truth_lines.strategist: Strategy is a bet placed, not a plan admired.
face_truth_lines.catalyst: Ignition matters only if the flame sustains.
face_truth_lines.diplomat: Only bridges that bear weight should stand.
face_truth_lines.sentinel: A real gate opens and closes cleanly on the stated rule.
face_truth_lines.artisan: Craft is proven in use, not in the studio.
face_truth_lines.navigator: Pick a heading and adjust underway.
face_truth_lines.alchemist: Transformation honors cost while changing form.

line_note_templates.C: Stable: the move lands cleanly without extra passes.
line_note_templates.F: Break: pattern derails or reverses motion under pressure.

logic.readme: Run FH loop serving 5-option router items until any family hits count=3. Lock that family. Ask 3 face triad items; compute counts and apply duel rules. Then run Lines: 14 items (2 per line). Produce code_7 + notes + truth_line. See duel_rules for exact sequences.
